classes.protection: Family, household, and intimate-circle communications propagate unconditionally. Standing never gates messages between agents already in a verified relationship.
Anyone holding a CID can fetch the content. Standing modulates discovery (what surfaces in feeds) but never retrievability (what an explicit fetch returns).
Mishpat decisions, qahal ratifications, and imagodei-as-counsel signatures are always per-message verified. Author standing cannot suppress these signature checks.
First-time authors receive a non-zero baseline floor derived from their sponsor's standing. No agent ever starts at zero — bootstrapping is itself a relationship event.
Children, refugees, persecution-targets, and displaced persons receive an elevated baseline floor. The protocol must not amplify existing structural disadvantage.
